message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features a man holding a red square frame containing a painted portrait of himself. The man, visible from the chest down, wears a white t-shirt and blue jeans. He holds the frame from the bottom with his right hand, while his left hand, which extends from outside the frame into the painted space, holds a thin paintbrush poised near the portrait’s eye. The hand holding the brush wears a silver watch. 

Inside the red frame, a painted man with glasses and a white button-down shirt smiles. The painting within the frame shows a shadow cast against a grey background. 

The magazine title "TEMPO" is printed in large red letters at the top. Below it reads "EDISI 25 JUNI-1 JULI 2012". Text at the top includes "SKANDAL VAKSIN NAZARUDDIN", "WAWANCARA KHUSUS UMAR PATEK", and "MAIN UANG KOMISIONER OJK". On the left, bold text reads "LUKISAN PALSU SANG MAESTRO," followed by smaller black and red text. A price "RP 29.700" and a barcode are located in the bottom left corner.
